name: Gram Hazar
source:
One of the heroes who led the war to victory 15 years ago.
As a result of his immersing in battle, his body was integrated with armor.
He is currently the boss of the mafia, running an arena in a slum area to make money.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
